marcadores.explicacao_original: The arrector pili muscle is band of smooth muscle anchored at one end in the papillary layer of the dermis and attached to the hair follicle at the other, in a specialized stem-cell niche called the follicular bulge. Contraction of the arrector pili elevates the hair shaft and produces depressions on the skin surface called “goose flesh”.
